HBAR.summary: Mixed for the short. The Deutsche Bank staking headline (via Taurus) is bullish, but the HBAR ETF has had flat flows since Oct 2 and Hitachi left the council. No unlock overhang.

news.title: Taurus integration gives Deutsche Bank HBAR staking and tokenization; Hitachi exits Hedera council
HBAR's monthly gain seen as retail-driven while its spot ETF took no new money Oct 2-12
Hedera spot ETF among altcoin funds with zero net flows on Oct 13

FET.summary: No FET-specific catalyst and no unlock overhang. FET fell about 9% in the Oct 13 AI/KOSPI selloff, so the long depends on AI-sector risk sentiment recovering.

news.title: KOSPI crash drags AI tokens lower; FET down about 9% on the day

APT.summary: Supportive for the long: contributor and investor vesting ended in October, cutting monthly unlocks about 60% to ~4.5M APT. Encrypted mempool and Block-STM v2 went live. Next (smaller) unlock is Nov 11-12.

news.title: Aptos contributor/investor vesting ends; monthly releases fall ~60% to ~4.54M APT
Aptos enables opt-in encrypted mempool on mainnet
Block-STM v2 becomes the default execution engine on Aptos mainnet

unlock.note: Community and Foundation pools (monthly linear); contributor/investor vesting has ended. Some sources point to Nov 12.

SYRUP.summary: Steady fundamentals for the long: Q3 loans $1.67B (+12% YoY, -9% QoQ) with ongoing revenue buybacks. About 98% of supply circulates, so no unlock risk.

news.title: Maple Q3: loans outstanding $1.67B, up 12% YoY but down 9% QoQ
Citrini Research lists SYRUP among tokens to watch for institutional adoption

DOT.summary: Supports the short: DOT sold off after the dotUSD launch (~8.7% below Oct 10) amid debate over its USDT backing, and funding is slightly negative. Inflationary issuance, no discrete unlock.

news.title: DOT trades ~8.7% below its Oct 10 level near $1.16 despite the dotUSD referendum passing
Ref 1954 pushes dotUSD as Polkadot's preferred stablecoin, sparking USDT-backing debate
New DOT DAO strategy mandate proposed on OpenGov

SEI.summary: For the long, the Staked SEI ETF (REX-Osprey) has an Oct 23 effective date in its filing, though not SEC-approved. The Oct 15 unlock (~0.84% of circulating) is done; the next is Nov 15.

news.title: CFTC-regulated SEI perpetual futures go live for US users on OG.com Markets
Sei Giga roadmap marks Autobahn consensus mainnet as coming soon
About 55.6M SEI unlocked, roughly 0.84% of circulating supply

OP.summary: The short is against strong momentum: OP is up ~66% in four weeks on Unichain moving to OP Enterprise and planned buybacks (which only start Feb 2027). The Oct 29 Unichain mainnet cutover is a possible sell-the-news date. No unlock before December.

news.title: OP jumps 18% on Unichain migration and buyback plans, extending a 4-week rally
Unichain moves to OP Enterprise; mainnet cutover set for Oct 29
Lido adds direct ETH staking on Optimism and other L2s via Chainlink CCIP
OP Stack chains handled about two-thirds of Ethereum L2/L3 transactions Jan-Sep

INJ.summary: The short faces a fresh squeeze: INJ rose ~30% on Oct 16 after leadership met White House, SEC and CFTC officials, with open interest up 44%. Pending INJ ETF filings are the main headline risk. No unlocks.

news.title: INJ rallies about 30% after Injective leadership meets White House, SEC and CFTC officials
Analysts note the Washington meeting is not an approval and price may be ahead of facts

GRASS.summary: Clear supply catalyst for the short: ~31.6M GRASS (~4.5% of circulating, per DropsTab) unlocks Oct 28 as the extended contributor lock-up ends.

news.title: Grass launches a Contents API that turns web pages into clean text for AI agents
Grass Airdrop Season 2 claim deadline set for Jan 22, 2027

unlock.note: Contributors (team) cliff start after a one-year lock-up extension; date confirmed by Tokenomist, amount from DropsTab only

ONDO.summary: Fundamentals support the long (TVL above $4B, tokenized stocks growing). The risk is market share: DWF Labs puts Ondo's tokenized-equity share at 26%, down from 56%. Next unlock is Jan 18, 2027.

news.title: Ondo TVL tops $4B on tokenized stock growth
Ondo Intelligent Portfolios go live on Gate
DWF Labs: Ondo's tokenized-equity volume share falls to 26% from 56%

kPEPE.summary: For the long, Canary's amended spot PEPE ETF filing could revive speculative demand, but PEPE is a pure beta trade that fell after the hot CPI print. Fully circulating, no unlocks.

news.title: Canary Capital amends S-1 for a proposed spot PEPE ETF
PEPE shows the sharpest activity jump on Korean exchanges despite a daily drop

ARB.summary: Supply supports the short: the Oct 16 team/investor unlock (~1.56% of circulating) just landed, the DAO is voting on 100M more ARB for incentives, and the next unlock is Nov 16.

news.title: Monthly ARB unlock releases ~92.65M tokens (~1.56% of circulating) to team and investors
ArbitrumDAO votes on stablecoin incentives including 100M extra ARB for DRIP

unlock.note: Monthly cliff for team, advisors and investors

ETH.summary: Schwab's retail ETH rollout is a structural positive for the long, but spot ETF outflows, the CPI-driven selloff and a near-zero burn are near-term headwinds. No unlocks.

news.title: Charles Schwab opens spot ETH trading to eligible US retail clients
US spot ETH ETFs see ~$70M net outflows
Hot US CPI print triggers ~6% ETH drop and ~$950M in liquidations
ETH burn falls to about 0.5% of issuance as next-upgrade clients ship

HYPE.summary: For the long, Pump.fun's Hyperliquid perps front end adds volume, but spot HYPE ETFs posted their first weekly outflow in ten weeks. Next core-contributor unlock is Nov 6 (size undisclosed; Oct's batch went OTC).

news.title: US spot HYPE ETFs post ~$17.5M weekly outflow, ending a nine-week inflow streak
Pump.fun launches a perpetuals interface powered by Hyperliquid

unlock.note: Core contributors, monthly; Oct 6 batch (3.75M HYPE) was sold OTC to one buyer

ICP.summary: The ckSOL/ChatGPT-plugin bounce has faded (about $3.45 to $3.00), which suits the short; further DFINITY integration headlines are the squeeze risk. Inflationary supply, no discrete unlock.

news.title: DFINITY launches ckSOL for bridgeless ICP-Solana interaction
Official ICP plugin goes live in ChatGPT's plugin directory
ICP enables native protocol timers for self-scheduling canisters
.icp top-level domain application clears ICANN initial review
